[Question]
Why does Xiao Chu make a "successful gesture" to Xiao Li?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiao Chu is encouraging Xiao Li, letting him have confidence to face Xiao Min's doubts.
B. Xiao Chu makes this gesture to Xiao Li because he thinks this plan is definitely successful.

D. Xiao Chu and Xiao Li manage to successfully improve the team project without Xiao Min knowing.
